joints.handle_description: Protruding top rail of the door (23 mm proud, 40 mm tall) split into A/B/C; A is nearest centre. Bottom hinge, folds down toward viewer.

object_note: No separate handle; grip is the door's own top lip, shallow (23 mm) so pads engage marginally. B/C are the same rail. Red dot on panel is a model button.
